component_audit.correction: Darken and weather the sleepers, vary exposed edges and ballast coverage, and add the visible rail seats/fasteners rather than emphasizing clean repeated boards.

component_audit.target_observation: Dense irregular stones, coal grit and dirt form a dark, varied track bed with believable scale and accumulation around sleepers and rails.
component_audit.actual_observation: Small gray stones exist, but their distribution is comparatively sparse and regular against exposed brown sleepers. Dark coal grit, finer debris and natural accumulation are weak.
component_audit.correction: Match the stone-size mixture and density, fill the sleeper gaps naturally, and integrate dark fines, coal grit and localized debris around the rail seats.

component_audit.target_observation: Substantial warm brick piers separate arched glazed bays, with projecting arch courses and broad weathered stone sills. The near pier supports notices and distinct masonry relief.
component_audit.actual_observation: Oversized barred window fields and narrow dark dividers dominate the right side. The pier widths, bay rhythm, deep brick arches and chipped projecting sill remain unlike the target.
component_audit.correction: Rebuild the near pier/window proportions and projecting arches/sills in screen space before refining brick scale, mortar and localized soot.

component_audit.target_observation: Dark-green layered frames and finer mullions enclose reflective amber glass, with visible warm lamps, interior fittings and room depth behind the panes.
component_audit.actual_observation: Thick near-black bars sit in front of broad orange/beige wall-like fields and pale reveals. There is some interior-value variation, but glazing reflections, thin frame profiles and a layered occupied room do not read; this remains a major mismatch after the local facade changes.
component_audit.correction: Separate frames, glass and recessed interior planes; match mullion thickness and green finish, add restrained reflections and target-visible interior lamps/fittings, and remove the brick-backed or opaque-panel impression.

component_audit.target_observation: Tapered warm lanterns on ornate brackets punctuate the facade, with amber glow, local brick spill and interior lanterns visible through the nearest glass.
component_audit.actual_observation: Receding bright lamps are present but have simpler rectangular housings and stronger white cores. The large near-window interior lantern arrangement and its reflected light are not reproduced.
component_audit.correction: Match housing taper, bracket silhouettes and lamp spacing; restrain white clipping and restore the near interior lanterns with localized amber spill/reflections.

component_audit.target_observation: The circular aged-cream 9 3/4 sign near x1085,y157 has a dark rim, a large serif 9, smaller fraction and irregular enamel grime.
component_audit.actual_observation: This is one of the closest features: the circular placement, aged face, dark rim and numeral hierarchy are recognizable. The face is more uniformly amber and the exact fraction spacing, rim and grime pattern differ.
component_audit.correction: Preserve its successful placement and broad proportions; make only measured adjustments to numeral spacing, rim profile, cream tone and irregular aging.

component_audit.target_observation: A wrought-iron arm with varied scroll sizes, mounting plate, suspension and small upper ornament projects from the brick above the sign.
component_audit.actual_observation: The main arm and scroll silhouette are close in placement, but several loops are heavier and more uniform, the central curl reads as a solid dark disk, and finer mounting/ornament details differ.
component_audit.correction: Thin and vary the scroll profiles, open the central curl and match the visible mount, finial and suspension connections without moving the whole sign.

component_audit.target_observation: A clearly visible slatted bench around x1075-1190,y465-620 has an angled back, shaped seat, curved metal arms and slender legs beside the wall.
component_audit.actual_observation: The near bench is mostly hidden behind the shifted trolley and luggage. Its visible back is an upright dark mass with a few thick orange slats, and the arm/seat/leg curves do not reproduce the target.
component_audit.correction: Correct the bench's angle and placement, thin its slats and shape its arms/legs; reposition the trolley/luggage so the target-visible seat and back remain exposed.

component_audit.target_observation: A worn dark-brass trolley has a curved handle near x1210-1335, a small upper finial, slim tubing, a rounded tray and a dark wheel near x1205,y780.
component_audit.actual_observation: The handle begins farther left around x1140, the tray is broad and brightly gold, and the large wheel has a clean thick black tire and simplified hub. The shifted frame blocks the bench and lacks the target's aged delicacy.
component_audit.correction: Match handle and wheel placement, slim the tubing, round and darken the tray, refine axle/hub construction and restore the small visible finial and wear.

component_audit.target_observation: The large foreground brown leather trunk has rounded thick edges, a gently curved lid, worn straps, seams, handles, corner hardware and a readable front lock.
component_audit.actual_observation: A large brown case with straps and hardware occupies the right foreground, but it remains a rigid planar box with sharp lid transitions and a dark front face. Its surface reads more like flat stained panels than thick worn leather.
component_audit.correction: Round the lid and case thickness, establish leather seams and strap relief, match the front lock/handle layout and tune localized leather sheen and corner wear.

component_audit.target_observation: Several distinct worn cases stand beside the bench and farther down the wall, differing in size, orientation and leather tone while resting believably on the platform or trolley.
component_audit.actual_observation: Multiple cases are present, but oversized rectangular blocks around x960-1110 project too far into the walkway. The near supporting cases are boxier and their overlap with the bench/trolley differs.
component_audit.correction: Match each visible case's screen-space size and placement, restore rounded worn silhouettes and material variation, and maintain clear support and contact relationships.

component_audit.target_observation: A delicate brass cage near x1250-1395 has thin numerous bars, a rounded dome, several rings, small top finial and ring, an exposed base and mottled contents low inside.
component_audit.actual_observation: A domed cage is recognizable but broader and simpler, with thicker widely separated bars and fewer convincing horizontal layers. The oversized blanket hides the lower cage/base and any readable contents.
component_audit.correction: Match the cage envelope and position, thin/densify bars, refine dome/rings/finial and expose the base and low contents by correcting the blanket overlap.

component_audit.target_observation: A compact folded burgundy blanket sits on the right trunk around x1305-1495,y585-715, with soft layered folds, pale woven stripes and a naturally hanging fringe.
component_audit.actual_observation: Large rigid burgundy tiers extend left across the cage base and are clipped at the right image edge. Their angular slab-like waves, dark uniform color and comb-like fringe lack soft compression and the visible pale stripes.
component_audit.correction: Reduce and reposition the folded volume, soften and compress the layers onto the lid, add the visible woven stripes and irregular fringe, and keep the cage base and blanket silhouette correctly exposed.

component_audit.target_observation: A small round station clock hangs near x948,y350; framed notices occupy right brick piers, with varied minor luggage and dressing along the platform.
component_audit.actual_observation: The distant hanging disk repeats the 9 sign rather than showing a clock. The target-visible posters/notices are missing, while repeated benches and case blocks substitute for varied small dressing.
component_audit.correction: Replace the distant numeral disk with the target-style clock, add the visible framed notices in their exact wall regions and vary only the station dressing actually seen in the target.

component_audit.target_observation: Important black train and roof forms remain readable while the terminal and lanterns are luminous but retain surrounding detail; warm foreground reflections do not overpower the image.
component_audit.actual_observation: The locomotive underframe and portions of the facade are dark and poorly separated, while the flat roof, lamp cores and far-floor patch are conspicuously bright. Exposure is not uniformly too low; the distribution is wrong.
component_audit.correction: Recover local dark-form separation and control the bright terminal/floor and lamp values, preserving contrast instead of applying a global exposure increase.

component_audit.target_observation: Cool blue-gray roof transmission and terminal haze contrast with warm brick, restrained brass, oxblood paint and broken amber light on wet paving.
component_audit.actual_observation: The roof and terminal are mostly neutral gray, windows are broad orange/beige fields, and the scene lacks the target's cool atmospheric counterweight. Warm colors exist but are distributed across the wrong surfaces.
component_audit.correction: Establish cool roof/distance illumination and localized amber interior/lamp light; retain deep oxblood and brick without globally tinting all surfaces orange.

component_audit.target_observation: Broken amber/cool streaks follow the wet walkway; curved boiler metal, green window glass, leather and brass each show distinct localized reflections appropriate to their surfaces.
component_audit.actual_observation: Broad foreground paving sheen, repetitive bright seam dashes, a pale cab slab and flat window fields replace these shaped reflections. The central reflected-light trail and dark mirrored puddle are missing.
component_audit.correction: Place and shape reflections per surface: broken walkway streaks and pools, narrow curved boiler glints, layered glass reflections and restrained leather/brass highlights.

component_audit.target_observation: A soft gray plume rises from the chimney mouth, expands and drifts through the roof light, with translucent edges and uneven illuminated density.
component_audit.actual_observation: Bright narrow jets rise partly to the left near the lamp and separately at the chimney rim, then form a dense white column. The source, breadth, translucency and drift do not match.
component_audit.correction: Attach the emission convincingly across the mouth, remove the displaced left jet, widen and soften the plume, and let irregular translucent vapor drift through the roof light.

component_audit.target_observation: Low steam rolls irregularly around the forward wheels and rods, rising in local wisps and drifting near the rail while selectively revealing machinery.
component_audit.actual_observation: Several thin repeated horizontal white streaks cross the exposed wheels at similar heights. They read as stacked bands rather than low volumetric vapor interacting with the mechanism.
component_audit.correction: Replace the repeated stripes with irregular localized low plumes and soft expanding wisps, preserving clear rod/joint silhouettes and physically plausible occlusion.

component_audit.target_observation: Blue-gray atmosphere progressively separates roof trusses, train sections, columns and distant buildings without erasing the terminal structure.
component_audit.actual_observation: Dark repeating architecture runs into a flat neutral-gray closure and white floor pool. Intermediate depth layers and cool aerial separation remain weak.
component_audit.correction: After restoring distant geometry, introduce gradual cool extinction and illumination across multiple depths; keep the arch, lower supports and last carriage readable.

component_audit.target_observation: Fine irregular textures and delicate silhouettes remain coherent, with natural overlap, deliberate image-edge cropping and no repeated bright seam pattern.
component_audit.actual_observation: Fine roof/cage lines appear jagged or noisy, regular bright paving dashes repeat, the open lower locomotive exposes implausible gaps, and the oversized blanket is clipped at the right. Still images do not establish temporal shimmer or performance.
component_audit.correction: Remove repeated seam artifacts and incorrect overlaps/open gaps, correct blanket framing, then address residual fine-line aliasing without blurring geometry or using performance evidence as visual credit.

assessment: 5.4/10, unchanged from round 11. The broad train-left/platform-center/sign-and-props-right composition is recognizable, and the main sign remains comparatively close. Clearer upper-left greenish members and minor surface/steam differences do not restore the prominent opposing column silhouette or resolve any dominant region. The disconnected lower locomotive, blocky cab and repeated coach strip, thin roof tunnel, low blank terminal, wall-like right glazing, missing wet-light pattern and rigid foreground props remain major mismatches. No score increase is justified by the visible changes, final-candidate status or approaching deadline. Coverage is complete at 58/58, but no component is judged an exact match. The unchanged 8.0 visual threshold is not met, despite the separately reported performance pass.

fixes.title: Rebuild the connected lower locomotive rather than decorating isolated pieces
fixes.action: Treat beam, buffers, apron, cylinder casing, wheels, rods and frame as a single projected assembly. Lower the front, build the curved apron/cylinder transition and lower enclosure, remove the pendant coupling knot and connect broad rods, joints, guides and suspension against an appropriately dark chassis.
fixes.acceptance: Buffer centers fall near y575-580, the beam reaches roughly y618 and the forward tire roughly y715. Enlarged inspection shows a continuous curved cheek/cylinder connection, distinct attached hook/hoses and rod joints, and no inappropriate bare-axle opening. The mechanism reads correctly without steam.

fixes.title: Restore the actual opposing-column silhouette and exposed station architecture
fixes.action: Place the full substantial support where the target shows it, not merely thin roof lines above the facade. Build the shaft, pale layered capital and deep connected branches, then match the independently visible upper/lower bay rhythms, stone relief, gray platform and dense fence.
fixes.acceptance: The actual render visibly contains the support near x250 with its pale capital around y165-205 and branching fan, plus receding supports. Both storeys have appropriately scaled arches and projecting stonework; the raised platform/fence relationship is correct and the white lower strip is gone.

fixes.title: Reconstruct the roof envelope and layered terminal
fixes.action: Correct hall span, curvature and terminal projection before increasing detail. Use deep connected truss sections, separated secondary members and framed cool glazing. Provide visible lower terminal columns and distant structures with open continuation, and extend the train to its target endpoint.
fixes.acceptance: Terminal crown and crossbeam are approximately y270 and y335 instead of y330 and y385. The lower opening contains several readable structural/background layers, not a blank gray closure. The last train section reaches roughly x920-925, and enlarged trusses show real section depth and junctions.

fixes.title: Replace wall-like right glazing with masonry, glass and interior depth
fixes.action: Match pier/bay proportions, projecting arches and worn sills. Separate thinner green frames, reflective panes and recessed room geometry; place the visible warm lanterns and fittings. Add the exposed framed notices and correct the distant duplicate numeral sign to a clock.
fixes.acceptance: The nearest bay reads as reflective glass over an illuminated room, not heavy black bars over orange brick or pale panels. The broad notice-bearing pier, chipped sill, interior lanterns and distant clock are individually recognizable at the target positions.

fixes.title: Match the spatial wet-light pattern and cool atmospheric hierarchy
fixes.action: Remove regular white joint dashes, vary worn slabs and add shallow target-positioned pools with graded damp margins. Shape broken amber/cool reflections toward the distance, recover local dark-form separation and illuminate the roof/terminal coolly without a detached white floor hotspot.
fixes.acceptance: The dark irregular reflective pool around x925-1010, y675-715 is present, with broken wet-light continuity toward the vanishing region. Slab joints remain dark, important black machinery is readable, and cool distance contrasts with localized warm lamps rather than flat neutral-gray closure.

fixes.title: Resolve the upper locomotive and each connected rear train section
fixes.action: Give the smokebox its convex heavy rim, square lantern and aged steel response; shape the broad dome and worn oxblood barrel. Replace the bright blocky cab with curved roof and recessed framed openings, then resolve tender and coach bodies, underframes, doors and joins individually.
fixes.acceptance: A front-to-back crop traversal identifies the correct convex door, square lamp, broad dome, thin framed dark cab, distinct tender and separately connected curved-roof coaches. Neither a broad gray cab slab nor a continuous strip of identical amber panes dominates.

fixes.title: Recompose the foreground group and restore soft leather/fabric forms
fixes.action: Expose the angled bench, shift/slim the trolley, correct case sizes and round leather silhouettes. Reduce and soften the blanket with pale woven stripes and irregular fringe. Thin cage bars and expose its base and low contents.
fixes.acceptance: Bench back/seat/curved arms remain visible; the trolley does not intrude too far left. Rounded leather cases rest believably, and the blanket occupies approximately x1305-1495 without right-edge clipping or hiding the cage base.

fixes.title: Attach and shape steam as irregular vapor rather than repeated strips
fixes.action: Align the top plume with the chimney mouth, remove the lamp-side jet and create broader translucent drift. Replace repeated wheel streaks with irregular low expanding plumes that interact with the corrected rods, wheels and rails.
fixes.acceptance: The upper plume visibly originates across the mouth with soft uneven illuminated edges. Low vapor rolls and rises locally without repeated horizontal bands or hiding unresolved mechanical construction.

fixes.title: Finish track integration and preserve the relatively successful sign
fixes.action: Narrow polished rail heads, darken/partly bury sleepers and integrate dense varied ballast and fines. Refine sign fraction spacing and open bracket curls without moving the sign. Address remaining fine-line and highlight artifacts after structural corrections.
fixes.acceptance: The track no longer reads as an orange ladder over sparse gravel; rail profiles and contact are believable. Delicate edges remain coherent, and the main sign retains its close placement and scale.

component_audit.target_observation: The large front door has shallow convexity, a thick annular rim, a recessed seam and broken cool/amber reflections over blackened steel.

component_audit.target_observation: A bent latch, two right straps, left hinge hardware, perimeter rivets and oval 8 plate sit below a small square brass-framed lantern near (316,193).

component_audit.target_observation: The short black stack near x390 has a flared mouth, layered lip, shaped foot and narrow curved highlights against translucent steam.

component_audit.target_observation: Near x465-555, y480-605, a rounded red casing surrounds a dark circular cover; seams, bolts, pipes and piston guidework connect into the frame.

component_audit.target_observation: The forward near wheel is centered around (420,645), with fine warm-edged spokes and a dark tire reaching roughly y715, partly enclosed by the front mechanism.

component_audit.target_observation: The oxblood barrel changes contour along its length and joins a black forward section, with bands, seams and narrow irregular amber reflections over aged curved paint.

component_audit.target_observation: Around x665-750, the cab has a thin curved roof, an arched side opening, narrow gold-edged pillars, a tall door edge, steps and a recessed dark interior.

component_audit.target_observation: A broad, high vaulted hall combines a luminous central glazed span with substantial dark side roofs and a distant terminal crown near y270.
component_audit.actual_observation: The canopy remains a narrower regular tunnel converging toward an arch near y330. Its curvature, span, solid/glazed ratio and supporting hierarchy do not convey the target's expansive hall.

component_audit.target_observation: Deep curved chords, separated triangular webs and substantial joints overlap in dark-green iron, with plates and connected supports visible against the roof.
component_audit.actual_observation: Thin arcs and sparse zigzags create a wire-like grid on a flat gray backing. The newly clearer left-side lines do not supply deep chords, layered webs, plates or a convincing column junction.
component_audit.correction: Construct deep curved assemblies with separated chords, triangulated webs and visible connection plates, join them to restored supports and only then repeat them into depth.

component_audit.target_observation: Longitudinal beams, diagonals and purlins cross the main arches at different depths, creating layered overlaps and believable physical junctions.
component_audit.actual_observation: Longitudinal lines and diagonal pieces exist, including clearer teal-edged lines at the upper left, but remain thin and repetitive with weak depth ordering and attachment logic.
component_audit.correction: Give secondary members the correct section, spacing and depth, and visibly connect them to the primary trusses with target-like overlaps.

component_audit.target_observation: Framed blue-gray panes show restrained sky transmission, unequal brightness and dirt around edges beneath overlapping ironwork.
component_audit.actual_observation: The central glazed field is almost uniform neutral gray behind dark lines. Pane-specific transmission, frame depth, dirt distribution and sky structure are not convincingly readable.
component_audit.correction: Separate the framed panes, add subtle cool transmission and sky variation, and concentrate restrained dirt near edges instead of using one flat gray roof field.

component_audit.target_observation: Dark brown side-roof panels have fine seams, soot variation and scattered warm glints, with substantial iron supports distinctly layered beneath them.
component_audit.actual_observation: Dark ribbed side surfaces are present but nearly black and repetitive. Clearer upper-left green lines add some separation, not the target's rich brown panel response or deep support hierarchy.
component_audit.correction: Recover restrained brown panel values, varied seams and localized soot, and establish visible depth separation from the full connected support assemblies.

component_audit.target_observation: The broad terminal arch crowns near y270 above a strong crossbeam near y335; fine vertical/horizontal mullions divide cool luminous panes with distant structure visible beyond.
component_audit.actual_observation: The crown remains near y330 and the crossbar near y385. Sparse uneven mullions cross an almost featureless gray field with incorrect arch proportions and height.
component_audit.correction: Raise and reshape the arch and crossbeam to the target projection, then match fine pane divisions and transmitted background structure.

component_audit.target_observation: Below the terminal glazing, branching columns, crossing structure, open space and distant buildings form several cool layers around x900-970, y340-425.
component_audit.actual_observation: A flat gray rectangular closure beneath the low crossbar ends at an isolated white floor patch. The target's readable lower columns and continuing space are absent.
component_audit.correction: Add the visible lower supports, crossing members and farther structural/building layers with genuine open-space continuation; do not substitute a blank closure and bright floor patch.

component_audit.target_observation: Train, platform, columns, trusses and background structures overlap progressively into cool haze while retaining a detailed luminous vanishing region.
component_audit.actual_observation: Perspective convergence is present, but the short train endpoint, repetitive dark walls and blank low terminal close the space. A detached white floor patch replaces layered recession.
component_audit.correction: Correct the projected train/terminal/support relationships and establish several visible depth layers with gradual cool separation rather than a single gray endpoint.

component_audit.target_observation: Large worn rectangular slabs vary in alignment and tone, with dark joints, chipped edges and irregular damp regions that set the foreground scale.
component_audit.actual_observation: A slab layout is recognizable but remains regular, coarse and strongly repetitive. Bright short seam dashes recur across the walkway; round 12 shows more pronounced foreground granular sheen without correcting the slab pattern.
component_audit.correction: Match slab scale and layout, vary restrained per-slab wear and tone, darken recessed joints and remove the repeated white seam accents.

component_audit.target_observation: Damp stone transitions into shallow irregular reflective pools, including a distinct dark puddle around x925-1010, y675-715, with broken reflections continuing into the distance.
component_audit.actual_observation: Broad smooth-to-granular sheen covers large foreground regions, but the target puddle silhouette and graded wet/dry margins are absent. The middle platform lacks its patterned wet-light trail.
component_audit.correction: Place shallow irregular pools at the target locations, especially the foreground puddle, with graded damp margins and distinct roughness/reflection behavior from surrounding stone.

component_audit.target_observation: A narrow weathered pale-gray coping borders the track, with chipped light edges, readable elevation and a warmer inset paving strip following its perspective.
component_audit.actual_observation: The near edge is a dark regular strip with weak pale coping and limited wear. Its raised-face relationship and warm adjoining strip are less legible than the target.
component_audit.correction: Match coping width, height and projection; add broken pale edge wear and the adjacent warm strip without making a continuous artificial bright outline.

component_audit.target_observation: Parallel rails have narrow polished running tops, rusty side profiles and visible fastening/contact details integrated into the dark track bed.
component_audit.actual_observation: Parallel dark rails follow the scene perspective, but their broad simple profiles show weak separation between polished heads and rusted webs, with sparse readable fastenings.
component_audit.correction: Refine the cross-section and narrow running-top highlights, distinguish rusted sides and add the visible rail-seat/fastener groups with proper sleeper contact.

component_audit.target_observation: Dark weathered sleepers are partly buried in ballast, with irregular exposure, muted wood grain and rail-seat hardware.
component_audit.actual_observation: Clean orange-brown crosspieces are regularly exposed, creating a strong ladder pattern. Their color, width and burial depth are too uniform.
component_audit.correction: Darken and weather the sleepers, vary exposed edges and ballast coverage, and resolve the visible rail seats rather than emphasizing repeated clean boards.

component_audit.target_observation: Dense irregular stones, dark coal grit and finer dirt accumulate naturally between sleepers and around the rails.
component_audit.actual_observation: Small gray stones are visible but comparatively sparse and evenly distributed against exposed brown sleepers. Fine dark grit and varied accumulation are weak.
component_audit.correction: Match the stone-size mixture and density, fill gaps naturally and integrate dark fines, coal grit and localized debris around rail seats.

component_audit.target_observation: Substantial warm brick piers divide arched bays, with projecting arch courses, broad worn stone sills and a near pier carrying framed notices.
component_audit.actual_observation: Oversized barred fields and narrow dark dividers dominate. Pier widths, arch relief, bay rhythm and the chipped projecting sill do not match the target; the required near-pier notice area is unresolved.
component_audit.correction: Rebuild the projected pier/bay proportions and deep brick arches/sills, then tune brick scale, mortar and localized weathering.

component_audit.target_observation: Layered dark-green frames and finer mullions enclose reflective amber glass, with warm lanterns, interior fittings and room depth behind the nearest panes.
component_audit.actual_observation: Heavy near-black bars stand before broad orange/beige planes and pale reveals. Brick-like backing is apparent; glass reflections and a layered interior room do not read convincingly.
component_audit.correction: Separate masonry, thinner green frames, reflective glass and recessed interior geometry; add the target-visible lamps/fittings and remove the opaque backing-panel impression.

component_audit.target_observation: Tapered lanterns on ornate brackets create localized amber glows along the facade, while additional warm lanterns are visible through the nearest glass.
component_audit.actual_observation: Receding lamps exist but have simpler rectangular housings and bright white cores. The nearest interior lantern arrangement and associated glass reflections are missing.
component_audit.correction: Match housing taper, bracket profiles and spacing, contain the white cores and restore the near interior lamps with localized warm spill and reflections.

component_audit.target_observation: The aged cream circular 9 3/4 sign near (1085,157) has a dark rim, a large serif 9, a smaller fraction and irregular enamel grime.
component_audit.actual_observation: Placement, circular silhouette and numeral hierarchy are among the closest features. The face is more uniformly amber; fraction spacing, rim profile and grime distribution still differ.
component_audit.correction: Preserve the successful overall placement while making measured corrections to cream tone, fraction spacing, rim thickness and irregular enamel aging.

component_audit.target_observation: A projecting wrought-iron arm has varied open scrolls, a wall mounting plate, suspension connections and a small upper ornament.
component_audit.actual_observation: The broad arm and scroll arrangement is recognizable, but some loops are too heavy and uniform, the central curl becomes a dark solid-looking disk and mounting/ornament detail is simplified.
component_audit.correction: Thin and vary the scroll profiles, reopen the central curl and match the mount, finial and suspension connections without displacing the sign.

component_audit.target_observation: An exposed bench around x1075-1190, y465-620 has a slanted slatted back, shaped seat, curved arms and slender metal legs beside the brick wall.
component_audit.actual_observation: The bench is mostly hidden by the left-shifted trolley and luggage. Visible back pieces are thick horizontal orange slats on a very upright dark mass; seat, arms and leg curves do not match.
component_audit.correction: Correct the angle and position, thin the slats and shape the arms/legs; recompose trolley and cases so the target-visible bench remains exposed.

component_audit.target_observation: A worn dark-brass trolley has a curved handle near x1210-1335, a small upper finial, slim tubing, rounded tray and dark detailed wheel near (1205,780).
component_audit.actual_observation: The handle begins too far left near x1140. A broad bright gold tray, thick clean black tire and simple wheel center replace the target's aged lighter structure; the frame obscures the bench.
component_audit.correction: Match handle, tray and wheel placement, slim the tubing, round and darken the tray, refine axle/hub details and add the small visible finial and wear.

component_audit.target_observation: The foreground brown leather trunk has thick rounded edges, a gently curved lid, worn straps, seams, handles, corner hardware and a clear front lock.
component_audit.actual_observation: A strapped brown case occupies the correct general group, but its broad planar faces, sharp lid transition and dark front read as a rigid stained box. Hardware is present without the target's rounded leather form.
component_audit.correction: Round the case and lid thickness, model seam/strap relief and correct the lock/handle layout; use localized leather sheen and worn corners instead of flat panel response.

component_audit.target_observation: Distinct worn cases stand beside the bench and farther down the wall, varying in size, orientation and brown tone while resting clearly on the floor or trolley.
component_audit.actual_observation: Several cases exist, but large rectangular blocks around x960-1110 protrude too far into the walkway. Near cases have sharp boxy silhouettes and different overlaps with the bench and trolley.
component_audit.correction: Match each exposed case's placement and projected size, round worn edges, vary material response and preserve believable support/contact relationships.

component_audit.target_observation: The delicate brass cage near x1250-1395 has numerous thin bars, a rounded dome, multiple rings, a small finial/ring, an exposed base and mottled contents low inside.
component_audit.actual_observation: The dome is recognizable but broader and simpler, with thicker bars and less convincing ring layering. The large blanket hides the base and prevents the target's low contents from reading.
component_audit.correction: Match cage size and position, thin and densify bars, refine rings/dome/finial and expose the base and low contents by correcting the blanket overlap.

component_audit.target_observation: A compact burgundy folded blanket around x1305-1495, y585-715 has soft compressed layers, pale woven stripes and a naturally hanging irregular fringe.
component_audit.actual_observation: Oversized rigid burgundy tiers extend across the cage base and off the right image edge. Angular slab-like waves, uniform dark fabric and a comb-like fringe lack the target's soft folds and pale stripes.
component_audit.correction: Reduce and reposition the folded volume, soften and compress it onto the lid, add visible woven stripes and irregular fringe, and restore the target cage/blanket overlap without edge clipping.

component_audit.target_observation: A small round station clock hangs near (948,350); framed notices punctuate the right brick piers and varied small luggage and dressing recede along the platform.
component_audit.actual_observation: The distant hanging disk repeats the numeral sign instead of showing a clock. Framed notices are absent from the required visible wall regions, and repeated furniture/case blocks dominate the minor dressing.
component_audit.correction: Replace the distant duplicate numeral disk with the target-style clock, add the visible framed notices at the correct piers and match the exposed minor dressing rather than generic repetition.

component_audit.target_observation: Black train and roof forms remain readable, while lanterns and the terminal are luminous without erasing surrounding detail. Foreground reflected light remains localized.
component_audit.actual_observation: Dark underframe and facade regions have poor separation, while the roof backing, lamp cores and far-floor patch stand out brightly. More obvious foreground sheen in round 12 does not fix this distribution.
component_audit.correction: Recover local separation in dark machinery and architecture, control lamp/far-floor brightness and preserve contrast rather than globally increasing exposure.

component_audit.target_observation: Cool blue-gray roof transmission and distant haze contrast with warm brick, restrained brass, oxblood paint and broken amber reflections on damp stone.
component_audit.actual_observation: Roof and terminal remain mostly neutral gray, with broad orange/beige window fields and insufficient cool atmospheric counterweight. Slightly clearer green roof lines are only a local change.
component_audit.correction: Establish cool roof/distance illumination and localized amber lamp/interior light, retaining deep oxblood and warm brick without applying a uniform warm tint.

component_audit.target_observation: Broken amber/cool streaks follow the wet walkway; curved boiler steel, window glass, leather and brass each carry distinct surface-appropriate reflections.
component_audit.actual_observation: Broad foreground sheen, repeated bright paving dashes, a pale cab slab and wall-like window fields replace these shaped reflections. The central wet-light trail and dark mirrored puddle are still absent.
component_audit.correction: Shape reflections separately on each material: broken platform streaks and pools, narrow curved boiler glints, layered glass reflections and restrained leather/brass highlights.

component_audit.target_observation: Soft gray vapor rises from the chimney mouth, broadens and drifts into the roof light with irregular translucent edges and uneven illuminated density.
component_audit.actual_observation: Bright narrow vapor rises left of the stack near the lamp as well as at the rim, then becomes a dense white column. Source attachment, breadth, drift and translucency remain incorrect.
component_audit.correction: Emit convincingly across the mouth, remove the displaced lamp-side jet, broaden and soften the plume and introduce irregular translucent drift through roof illumination.

component_audit.target_observation: Low rolling vapor surrounds forward wheels and rods, with local rising wisps and near-rail drift selectively revealing the mechanism.
component_audit.actual_observation: Repeated thin white horizontal streaks cross the open red wheels at similar heights. Small density differences from round 11 do not change the stacked-band appearance.
component_audit.correction: Replace the repeated bands with irregular localized low plumes and soft expanding wisps, with believable depth occlusion around readable corrected rods and rails.

component_audit.target_observation: Blue-gray atmosphere progressively separates trusses, columns, coaches and distant buildings while preserving the terminal's visible structural layers.
component_audit.actual_observation: Dark repeated geometry terminates at a neutral-gray closure and bright floor pool. Intermediate atmospheric layers and cool aerial separation remain weak.
component_audit.correction: Restore the distant geometry first, then apply gradual cool extinction and illumination over several depths while keeping the arch, supports and final coach readable.

component_audit.target_observation: Fine irregular textures and delicate outlines remain coherent; prop overlap and image-edge cropping look deliberate, without repeated bright joint patterns.
component_audit.actual_observation: Roof/cage lines have jagged or stippled edges, foreground sheen is granular, bright seam dashes repeat and the lower locomotive exposes implausible open gaps. The large blanket is clipped at the right. Round 12 appears locally sharper/noisier than round 11, but still frames do not establish temporal shimmer.
component_audit.correction: Correct open gaps, prop overlap and cropping, remove repetitive joint highlights and then reduce residual fine-line/surface sampling artifacts without blurring the geometry.
